basic_details.job_title: SDO Shirpur Mahasul Sevak Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 34 Posts
basic_details.short_information: Office of the Sub-Divisional Officer, Shirpur Division, Shirpur, District Dhule (SDO Shirpur), Maharashtra, has invited applications for 34 posts of Mahasul Sevak (Kotwal) under Advt No. 01/2026. The online application is open from 5 November 2026 to 20 November 2026.

application_fee.details: Payment mode: Online by net banking, debit card, credit card, Google Pay or PhonePe; bank charges extra. Last date to pay the fee: 20 November 2026.

age_limit.age_details: 18 to 40 years age group (as on 5 November 2026)

qualification.education_qualification: Minimum educational qualification 4th pass; must be a local resident of a village in the saja applied for; physically fit for the duties
qualification.details: Qualification: Minimum educational qualification 4th pass; Local resident of a village included in the saja applied for; Physically capable of performing the duties of the post; Domicile of Maharashtra Age limit: 18 to 40 years age group (as on 5 November 2026) | Other conditions: | Must be a local resident of a village in the saja applied for Must submit a Maharashtra age and domicile certificate Must be physically capable of the field-level duties No criminal case recorded and no penalty or punishment by any court

exam_pattern.details: Exam for posts in all talukas of Shirpur sub-division on the same day at the same time Entry to the exam only with the admit card downloaded from the website

how_to_apply: Apply only online at https://dhule.bhartiportal.org from 05-11-2026 10.00 AM to 20-11-2026 05.45 PM.
Upload educational documents, other certificates, undertakings and the Gram Mahasul Adhikari's residence certificate for the saja village.
Upload a latest passport-size photo and signature, scanned as per the website instructions.
Pay the fee online by net banking, debit card, credit card, Google Pay or PhonePe.
Apply for only one saja; details filled in the online form cannot be changed.
important_instructions: Candidates registered earlier with employment exchange or other offices must apply online separately Number of posts and reservation may increase or decrease Admit card, schedule and notices only on the website; nothing sent by post No travel or other expense paid for the exam or document verification Each saja has one post; process is saja-wise

content_sections.heading: SDO Shirpur Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. 01/2026 gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download SDO Shirpur notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Minimum educational qualification 4th pass; Local resident of a village included in the saja applied for; Physically capable of performing the duties of the post; Domicile of Maharashtra Age limit: 18 to 40 years age group (as on 5 November 2026) Other conditions: Must be a local resident of a village in the saja applied for Must submit a Maharashtra age and domicile certificate Must be physically capable of the field-level duties No criminal case recorded and no penalty or punishment by any court

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for SDO Shirpur Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates with more than two children born after 28-03-2005 (small family declaration required) No reservation for persons with disabilities on this post No horizontal reservation for project-affected persons, ex-servicemen or sportspersons

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Post is purely temporary Terms as per Revenue and Forest Department resolution No. PKA/1051/L-6 dated 07-05-1959 Caste validity certificate within 6 months of provisional appointment, else appointment cancelled retrospectively

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: Payment mode: Online by net banking, debit card, credit card, Google Pay or PhonePe; bank charges extra. Last date to pay the fee: 20 November 2026.

rows.event: Last date for online application (05.45 PM)
Last date for online fee payment (05.45 PM)

content_sections.heading: How Will SDO Shirpur Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Written examination (100 marks, minimum 40 marks) Original document verification Final selection list Objective multiple-choice written test of 50 questions on general knowledge, 100 marks Minimum 40 marks in the written test required Provisional list for original document verification by written-test merit, published at the Tahsil office and website Final selection list published after document verification Heirs of the previous Kotwal of that saja get preference when all else is equal

content_sections.heading: SDO Shirpur Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: Exam for posts in all talukas of Shirpur sub-division on the same day at the same time Entry to the exam only with the admit card downloaded from the website

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Original educational and other certificates at document verification Caste certificate and, where applicable, non-creamy layer certificate valid up to 31-03-2027 Police station certificate of good character / no criminal record Physical fitness certificate from the Superintendent, Rural Hospital or a senior medical officer Affidavit on Rs. 100 stamp paper of no connection with any political party Small family declaration in Form A and Maharashtra age and domicile certificate

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for SDO Shirpur Recruitment 2026 Online
content_sections.text: Apply only online at https://dhule.bhartiportal.org from 05-11-2026 10.00 AM to 20-11-2026 05.45 PM. Upload educational documents, other certificates, undertakings and the Gram Mahasul Adhikari's residence certificate for the saja village. Upload a latest passport-size photo and signature, scanned as per the website instructions. Pay the fee online by net banking, debit card, credit card, Google Pay or PhonePe. Apply for only one saja; details filled in the online form cannot be changed.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Candidates registered earlier with employment exchange or other offices must apply online separately Number of posts and reservation may increase or decrease Admit card, schedule and notices only on the website; nothing sent by post No travel or other expense paid for the exam or document verification Each saja has one post; process is saja-wise
